_about: Every product feature named in the old site, the staging build, the website quote and the Enterprise Module scope. Each must appear on at least one page: run `python3 scripts/check-features.py`. Source codes: OLD = zeenovo.com, STG = staging build, ENT = Enterprise Module proposal, DES = approved design, DUMMY = placeholder.

adaptiveAssessment.title: Adaptive assessments
adaptiveAssessment.text: Questions change with the patient's sex and each answer, and the next relevant question is suggested automatically.

provinceLogic.title: Province-specific logic
provinceLogic.text: Each assessment follows the scope, conditions and terminology of the province the pharmacist practises in.

redFlags.title: Smart red flags
redFlags.text: Red flags are raised automatically from the answers given, with referral criteria shown where the decision is made.

healthFlags.title: Patient health flags
healthFlags.text: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, allergies, immunocompromised status and existing diagnoses are flagged on the record.

preVisitQuestionnaire.title: Pre-visit questionnaire
preVisitQuestionnaire.text: Patients answer intake questions before the visit, so the consultation starts with their history already captured.

guidedTreatment.title: Guided treatment paths
guidedTreatment.text: Treatment and self-care options are laid out by condition. The pharmacist confirms or changes every step.

conditionLibrary.title: 28 minor ailment conditions
conditionLibrary.text: Skin, infection, digestive, pain, respiratory, women's health and oral conditions, shown according to your province's list.

medicineSig.title: Medicine and SIG by condition
medicineSig.text: Suggested medicine and directions for use are generated from the assessment for the pharmacist to confirm.

multiSig.title: Multiple SIGs per platform
multiSig.text: Directions are formatted for the prescribing platform your pharmacy uses.

customDrug.title: Custom drug selection
customDrug.text: Choose any medicine and SIG when the suggestion does not fit the patient.

selfCare.title: Self-care suggestions
selfCare.text: Self-care advice for the condition appears beside the treatment options and is included in the record.

rxRequests.title: Prescription requests
rxRequests.text: Refill, new, repeat and transfer requests arrive in one queue, each with a clear status.

calendar.title: Customizable calendar
calendar.text: Time slots by pharmacist and by service, with time blocks and multi-staff scheduling.

walkIn.title: Walk-in intake
walkIn.text: Walk-in patients are triaged into the same queue as online bookings, in a few minutes.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.text: Patients join a waitlist when a service is full, and cancellations are filled from it.

groupBooking.title: Group booking
groupBooking.text: Book a family or a vaccine clinic in one appointment. One setting turns it on.

holidays.title: Holiday management
holidays.text: Block dates once and every service and team calendar updates.

bulkServices.title: Bulk service control
bulkServices.text: Enable, disable or waitlist several services at once.

serviceLinks.title: Per-service booking links
serviceLinks.text: Every service has its own booking link to share on social media, by email or in ads.

bookingSource.title: Booking source tracking
bookingSource.text: Each appointment records where it came from: website, portal, voice, walk-in, staff, referral or campaign link.

csvImport.title: CSV patient import
csvImport.text: Bring your patient list across from your pharmacy management system, so booking finds patients instantly.

autoFollowup.title: Automated follow-ups
autoFollowup.text: Patients receive follow-up questions by email. Only the cases that need a pharmacist are flagged for review.

followupTracking.title: Follow-up tracking and outcomes
followupTracking.text: See follow-up status and record resolved, improved or persistent symptoms on the same record.

followupScheduling.title: Follow-up scheduling
followupScheduling.text: Schedule the next check at the end of a visit, with a clear date for the team.

doseReminders.title: Dose reminders
doseReminders.text: Second doses, boosters and injection doses are reminded automatically, with a link to book.

familyDoctor.title: Family physician lookup
familyDoctor.text: The patient's family physician is found within the flow, saved, and reused at every visit and fax.

prm.title: Patient relationship management
prm.text: Visit history, communication and follow-ups stay with the patient for continuity of care.

autofillPrefs.title: Autofill preferences
autofillPrefs.text: Saved inputs fill repeat fields, so assessments move faster.

autoDocs.title: Automated documentation
autoDocs.text: Every assessment generates its PDF documentation as the consultation happens.

efax.title: Built-in eFax
efax.text: Self-fax a copy, auto-fax the family physician or download the documents, chosen visit by visit.

storage.title: Compliant storage
storage.text: Records are stored in Canada with encryption and role-based access.

auditRecords.title: Audit-ready records
auditRecords.text: Every record and change is logged and can be exported for an inspection.

vaccinePrograms.title: COVID-19, flu and other vaccines
vaccinePrograms.text: Publicly funded and private vaccine programs, each with its own booking and documentation.

vaccineAutofill.title: One-click vaccine auto-fill
vaccineAutofill.text: Vaccine, lot and dose details are reused across a clinic session instead of retyped.

quickVaccineFlow.title: Quick vaccine appointment flow
quickVaccineFlow.text: A short flow from booking to documentation for vaccine visits.

injections.title: Injection management
injections.text: Medicine injections booked as a service, with dose series and rebooking links.

medicationReview.title: Medication reviews
medicationReview.text: Medication list, issues, interventions, care plan and physician note in one structured review.

poct.title: Point of care testing
poct.text: Book the test, record the result and act on it within the consultation record.

unlimitedUsers.title: Unlimited users
unlimitedUsers.text: Every team member has their own login and role, with no per-seat fees.

quickSetup.title: Set up in a day
quickSetup.text: Import patients, choose services and start booking, usually within one day.

incidentCapture.title: Incident and near-miss capture
incidentCapture.text: Log incidents and near misses quickly, including the close calls that prevent future harm.

guidedReporting.title: Guided reporting
guidedReporting.text: Step-by-step fields take a report from over 20 minutes to under 5, without missing required details.

nidr.title: NIDR-aligned categories
nidr.text: Fields and categories map to the National Incident Data Repository, so reports are ready for submission.

deidentify.title: De-identification
deidentify.text: Patient and staff details are protected, so the team can report and learn safely.

rca.title: Root cause analysis
rca.text: A guided 5 Whys finds where in the process the gap occurred.

contributingFactors.title: Contributing factors
contributingFactors.text: Classify the human, system and environmental factors behind each event with a standard taxonomy.

caseManagement.title: Case management
caseManagement.text: Review, assign, filter and close cases, with notes and a status on every one.

actionPlans.title: Action plans and reminders
actionPlans.text: Every analysis becomes an action plan with owners, due dates and automatic reminders.

multiStore.title: Multi-pharmacy view
multiStore.text: Track incidents by store, staff member, date and severity, at store or corporate level.

trendDashboards.title: Trend dashboards
trendDashboards.text: Error types, time-of-day patterns and medications involved, updated as reports arrive.

insightAlerts.title: Insight surfacing
insightAlerts.text: Spikes, drops and emerging patterns are flagged automatically.

performanceView.title: Performance at a glance
performanceView.text: Follow-up success rate, pharmacy safety score and productivity on one view.

scheduledReports.title: Scheduled reports
scheduledReports.text: Reports for your team, board or inspector, sent on a schedule or on demand.

benchmarking.title: Anonymised benchmarking
benchmarking.text: Compare your safety performance with anonymised peer pharmacies.

crossProduct.title: Cross-product insight
crossProduct.text: Clinical volume, website bookings and safety trends side by side.

exports.title: Audit-ready exports
exports.text: Download reports in the format your board, banner or college expects.

sop.title: SOP and document management
sop.text: Create, share and version policies and SOPs, with revision tracking and audit summaries.

cqi.title: CQI meetings
cqi.text: Run and record Continuous Quality Improvement meetings inside the platform.

goals.title: Goal tracking
goals.text: Set and review improvement goals, each linked to the incident that prompted it.

correctiveActions.title: Corrective action tracking
correctiveActions.text: See which goals and corrective actions are complete, open or overdue.

staffTraining.title: Staff assessment and training
staffTraining.text: Record staff assessments and training, and track completion across the team.

mssa.title: ISMP MSSA included
mssa.text: The ISMP Medication Safety Self-Assessment, completed every two years and tracked in ZeeNovo.

selfAssessment.title: Pharmacy self-assessment
selfAssessment.text: Check your safety score against inspection standards before inspectors arrive, at no extra cost.

userAccess.title: Independent user access
userAccess.text: Each team member has their own login, and several users can work across locations at once.

siteDesign.title: On-brand design
siteDesign.text: Your name, logo and colours on a mobile-first site, with no web skills needed.

liveBooking.title: Live booking
liveBooking.text: Patients book the services you offer, at the times you have open.

siteServiceControl.title: Service on/off control
siteServiceControl.text: Turn a service on or off on the website from your dashboard, instantly.

categoryPages.title: Category landing pages
categoryPages.text: Ready-made pages for vaccines, minor ailments and every other service category.

seo.title: Search-friendly
seo.text: Fast, structured pages built to be found by patients searching locally.

liveSync.title: Live sync with ZeeNovo
liveSync.text: The site stays in step with your ZeeNovo services and calendar.

siteIncluded.title: Included with every plan
siteIncluded.text: The website comes with every ZeeNovo plan, separate from the patient portal.

voiceBooking.title: Voice-based booking
voiceBooking.text: Patients book in plain language, hands-free. ZeeNovo matches the request to a service and an open time.

manageAppointments.title: Manage appointments
manageAppointments.text: Patients book, reschedule and cancel their own appointments.

portalRx.title: Online prescription requests
portalRx.text: Refills, renewals and transfers requested without a phone call.

portalReminders.title: Reminders and follow-ups
portalReminders.text: Dose reminders, follow-up questions and next-visit links in one place.

patientLogins.title: Independent patient logins
patientLogins.text: Each patient has a secure login of their own, separate from the pharmacy website.

masterFormulas.title: Master formulas
masterFormulas.text: One approved version of every formula, with change history.

batchRecords.title: Batch records
batchRecords.text: Ingredients, lot numbers, quantities and who prepared each batch.

budDates.title: Beyond-use dates
budDates.text: Calculated for each batch and printed on the label.

prepSteps.title: Guided preparation steps
prepSteps.text: Each step of the master formula confirmed before the next.

secondCheck.title: Second check
secondCheck.text: A second person verifies the batch before release.

compoundLabels.title: Labels from the batch record
compoundLabels.text: Labels generated from the batch record, so they always match.

chainPlatform.title: Branded chain booking platform
chainPlatform.text: A booking site in your group's name, logo and colours, on a ZeeNovo subdomain or your own domain.

serviceFirst.title: Service-first booking
serviceFirst.text: Patients choose a service, then a pharmacy by province that offers it. Booking continues in the pharmacy's ZeeNovo calendar.

central.title: ZeeNovo Central
central.text: A public directory of every ZeeNovo pharmacy, searchable by location and service.

execSummary.title: Executive summary
execSummary.text: Eight headline figures on one screen, from active pharmacies to confirmed positive outcomes.

reportingParameters.title: Fifteen reporting parameters
reportingParameters.text: Network status, adoption, services, patients, utilisation, value, appointments, booking origin, programs, follow-up and quality.

drillDowns.title: Program drill-downs
drillDowns.text: Minor ailments, flu and COVID-19, medication reviews and follow-up, each on its own view.

locationComparison.title: Location comparison
locationComparison.text: Member pharmacies side by side, on the same definitions and thresholds.

periodComparison.title: Period-over-period comparison
periodComparison.text: Every figure compares with the previous period.

methodology.title: Methodology page
methodology.text: Every calculation documented, so a number means the same thing at network, province and pharmacy level.

networkQuality.title: Network quality analytics
networkQuality.text: Incidents, CQI, SOP completion, staff training, self-assessment and goals across the network.

serviceValues.title: Estimated service value
serviceValues.text: Set service values to estimate the value of clinical care delivered. Shown as an estimate, not claims.

minimumCohort.title: Minimum cohort size
minimumCohort.text: Groups too small to report safely show "insufficient data" instead of a number.

suppression.title: Complementary suppression
suppression.text: A hidden figure cannot be worked out from the totals around it, in cards, charts, tables or downloads.

noPatientData.title: No patient-level data
noPatientData.text: Names, health card numbers, medication names and notes never reach enterprise users.

accessLogs.title: Access and export logs
accessLogs.text: Role-based access, with every view and export logged.

communication.title: Network communication
communication.text: Message the whole network, one province or one pharmacy. It lands in a single inbox on each pharmacy's dashboard.

messageAlerts.title: Message categories and alerts
messageAlerts.text: Messages are categorised, and email only tells a pharmacy that a message is waiting.

onboarding.title: Member onboarding
onboarding.text: Send us your member list. Track each pharmacy as invited, onboarding, activated, inactive or suspended.

roles.title: Roles and capabilities
roles.text: Give each user reporting, communication, network or user management rights.

primaryAdmin.title: Primary Admin and forced lockout
primaryAdmin.text: One Primary Admin controls brand, domain and immediate account lockout. The role can be transferred, never removed.
